verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Software initialization sequence — PCI cfg enable → ABAR map → GHC.AE → CAP / CAP2 / PI read → per-port init (PxCLB / PxFB / PxCMD.FRE / PxCMD.SUD / PxCMD.ST).
HBA Reset — GHC.HR self-clearing behavior; verify reset values of all RW registers.
Port Reset — PxSCTL.DET=1 → 0; verify COMRESET / COMINIT / COMWAKE on the link; verify PxSSTS.DET / SPD / IPM transitions.
Software Reset (SRST sequence) — two CFISes with R=1 + SRST=1 then SRST=0.
Device Signature load — verify PxSIG matches device class (0x00000101 / 0xEB140101 / 0xC33C0101 / 0x96690101).
Speed Negotiation — verify all three Gens (1.5 / 3 / 6 Gbps); verify PxSCTL.SPD cap behavior.
All-FIS-type coverage — Register H2D (0x27), Register D2H (0x34), DMA Activate (0x39), DMA Setup (0x41), Data (0x46), BIST Activate (0x58), PIO Setup (0x5F), Set Device Bits (0xA1).
Received FIS Structure placement — verify DSFIS / PSFIS / RFIS / SDBFIS / UFIS sub-areas populated correctly.
Non-NCQ DMA Read / Write — single command end-to-end with PRDT.
PIO transfer — IDENTIFY DEVICE 0xEC; verify PIO Setup FIS + Data FIS + D2H Register FIS.
NCQ Read / Write — READ FPDMA QUEUED 0x60 / WRITE FPDMA QUEUED 0x61 with NCQ tag; verify Set Device Bits FIS clears PxSACT.
NCQ at full depth — 32 outstanding commands; verify completion bitmaps.
Multi-port concurrency — issue commands on multiple ports simultaneously.
ATAPI command — PxCMD.ATAPI=1; verify A bit + ACMD region handling.
FIS-Based Switching — PxFBS.EN=1 with Port Multiplier; verify per-PMP context tracking.
Command-Based Switching — PMP routing via H2D Register FIS PMP field.
Hot plug — insert / remove device; verify PxSSTS.DET / PxSERR.DIAG.X / PxIS.PCS.
Cold Presence Detect — verify PxIS.CPDS when PxCMD.CPD=1.
Mechanical Presence Switch — verify PxIS.DMPS when CAP.SMPS=1 + PxCMD.MPSP=1.
Power Management — Active / Partial / Slumber transitions; verify PMREQ / PMACK / PMNAK primitive exchange via PxSSTS.IPM.
Aggressive Link PM — verify auto-Partial / auto-Slumber when PxCI=0 + PxSACT=0 + PxCMD.ALPE + ASP.
Automatic Partial→Slumber — verify CAP2.APST + PxCMD.APSTE behavior.
Device Sleep (AHCI 1.3.1) — PxCMD.ICC=8h → DEVSLP HIGH → PxSSTS.IPM=8h; verify exit timing per PxDEVSLP.DETO.
Aggressive Device Sleep — PxDEVSLP.ADSE + CAP2.SADM auto-assert DEVSLP after DITO.
Command Completion Coalescing — verify CCC_CTL.TV timeout + CCC_CTL.CC count gate single CCC interrupt; verify CCC_PORTS bitmap.
Enclosure Management — verify CAP.EMS + EM_LOC + EM_CTL message transmit / receive (LED / SAF-TE / SES-2 / SGPIO).
BIOS/OS Handoff — CAP2.BOH + BOHC; verify BOS / OOS / OOC / SOOE / BB protocol.
Activity LED — verify per-port LED toggles on data transfer (CAP.SAL=1).
Staggered Spin-up — verify PxCMD.SUD=0 default when CAP.SSS=1; PxCMD.SUD=1 triggers Phy initialization.
Interrupt aggregation — verify per-port PxIS gated by PxIE OR'd through IS.IPS[port] through GHC.IE to PCI INTx / MSI / MSI-X.
MSI — verify MSICAP.MSIE + Multiple Message Enable; verify MRSM single-MSI fallback.
Error path: Task File Error — induce ERR bit; verify PxIS.TFES + PxTFD.ERR.
Error path: Unknown FIS — inject illegal FIS type; verify UFIS + PxSERR.DIAG.F + PxIS.UFS.
Error path: PRD Overflow — verify PxIS.OFS.
Error path: Incorrect PMP — verify PxIS.IPMS.
Error path: Interface Fatal / Non-fatal — induce CRC errors; verify PxIS.IFS / INFS + PxSERR bits.
Asynchronous Notification — verify CAP.SSNTF + PxSNTF set on SDB FIS with N bit.
64-bit addressing — verify PxCLBU / PxFBU / DBAU when CAP.S64A=1.
AHCI Version (VS) — verify 0x00010301 for 1.3.1; 0x00010300 for 1.3.
PCI Power Management — verify D0 ↔ D3HOT transitions; D1 / D2 not supported.
fields.notes: AHCI 1.3.1 is a normative register / FIS / state-machine specification but does not ship a formal testbench. SATA-IO (Serial ATA International Organization) maintains a separate Serial ATA Interoperability Program and the AHCI Interoperability Compliance Suite, which are the industry-standard verification harness.
